rationale.selected_because: The latest events add the invoice and expose a material remittance conflict. The attachment reports £95 diagnostic attendance, £19 VAT and £114 total, while Rowan separately requests different bank details. The diagnostic visit was approved, but the quoted repair was not; the written job sheet remains outstanding. Register the invoice, notify the landlord of the current position, request human review of the bank-detail discrepancy before any payment instruction, and await the already-requested work report. The invoice is reported evidence, not independent verification.

The written job sheet is still outstanding and the quoted repair remains unapproved. Rowan has also requested different remittance details from those on the invoice; that discrepancy is under review and is not authorization to change payment details.
